reason: The strainer is clogged and flow has stopped, so using the service tool there seems like the natural first step. It is also the only offered action.
expectation: I expect to open or clear the strainer and perhaps restore flow, though the sludge may need further attention.

effect: Backflushing restored the water flow and collected the blockage for investigation. The curled flecks suggest the residue may contain more than fine sludge.
reaction: I’m curious about what the flecks are and where they came from.
reason: Filtering the collected residue is the only offered combination and may separate the flecks from the finer material for examination.
expectation: I expect the cloth to separate some material from the residue, though I’m unsure exactly what it will reveal.

effect: The membrane separated and spread out the flecks, revealing a regular row of projections on one. Microscopy may make that structure clearer.
reaction: The regular projections make me curious about what the fleck is.
reason: Examining the membrane under the microscope is the only offered combination and should help investigate the blockage.
expectation: I expect a closer view of the flecks, though I don't know whether it will identify them.

effect: The microscope revealed a segmented body with limbs among the residue, and the record was sent to Earth. The chapter ends without identifying it or explaining how it entered the water system.
reaction: The tiny joints were unsettling and surprising after the blockage first looked like ordinary sludge.

mostWorthwhile.text: Examining the fleck under the microscope was most worthwhile: its visible structure transformed a routine repair into a discovery and left a compelling question.

leastWorthwhile.text: Filtering the residue was a useful preparation, but less engaging as a decision because it was the only combination offered.

surprise.text: I did not expect the fleck to have limbs and a segmented body.

arbitrary.text: None felt arbitrary; each action followed the investigation, although every step had only one offered combination.

continue.text: Yes. I would want to learn what the body is and how it reached the water system.
